camel_example: aliyun sas CreateFileProtectRule --region cn-hangzhou --FileOps.1 CHMOD --ProcPaths.1 '/usr/local/0' --RuleAction pass --RuleName tetsRule --FilePaths.1 '/usr/0'
description_en: Creates a core file monitoring rule
description_zh: 新建核心文件防护规则
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-file-protect-rule --rule-name tetsRule --proc-paths /usr/local/0 --file-paths /usr/0 --file-ops CHMOD --rule-action pass --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFileProtectRule

parameters.help_en: The paths to the processes that you want to monitor. Wildcard characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 对进程监听的路径列表，支持通配
parameters.name: proc_paths

parameters.help_en: The paths to the files that you want to monitor. Wildcard characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 监控的文件路径列表，支持通配
parameters.name: file_paths

parameters.help_en: The operations that you want to perform on the files
parameters.help_zh: 对文件进行的操作列表
parameters.name: file_ops

parameters.help_en:
The handling method of the rule. Valid values:

pass: allow
alert
parameters.help_zh:
规则在客户端的表现形式。取值如下：

pass： 放过

alert： 告警
parameters.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en:
The severity of alerts. Valid values:

0: does not generate alerts
1: sends notifications
2: suspicious
3: high-risk
parameters.help_zh:
报警通知级别。取值如下：

0：不告警

1： 提醒

2： 可疑

3： 高危
parameters.name: alert_level

parameters.help_en: The switch ID of the rule
parameters.name: switch_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Valid values:

1: yes
0: no
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态。
1：已启用
0：未启用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the operating system. Valid values:

windows: Windows
linux: Linux
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统类型。取值：

windows：Windows
linux：Linux
parameters.name: platform

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
